verdict.rationale: First-party docs define a skill as a directory containing a plain `SKILL.md` file (with name/description frontmatter) plus optional scripts and references, built on the open agent skills standard. A hands-on probe used third-party tooling to install a catalog skill as a plain folder with a valid `SKILL.md`, confirming it is not a locked binary format. missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of a skill actually running in a different non-Codex harness (the probe installed into a Codex-targeted `.agents/skills` path).

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: A skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` file plus optional scripts and references. The `SKILL.md` file must include `name` and `description`.
Skills build on the open agent skills standard.
the catalog's skills are plain portable folders that third-party tooling can install, not a Codex-locked format.
For a portable Agent Plugins package, add `plugin.json` at the plugin root and declare the Agent Plugins schema.
